summary: Amylmetacresol is an antiseptic used with dichlorobenzyl alcohol in sore-throat lozenges (0.6 mg with 1.2 mg). It is available over the counter in the UK and EU.
indications: Symptomatic relief of sore throat and mouth infections

dosage.d: 1 lozenge dissolved slowly every 2 to 3 hours

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Antiseptic with some local anaesthetic (sodium-channel) activity.
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
